Maximum capacity (Emax) 10 kg up to 50 kg 50 kg up to and including 500 kg
Minimum dead load 0 kg
Accuracy Class C
Rated Output 2,0 mV/V
Maximum number of load cell intervals (n) (1) 4000 6000
Ratio of minimum LC Verification interval (1) Y = Emax / vmin 20000
Ratio of minimum dead load output return (1) Z = Emax / (2 * DR) 6600 7500
Input impedance 415 Ω ± 65 Ω
Temperature range -10 °C / + 40 °C
Fraction pLC 0,7
Humidity Class CH
Safe overload 150 % of Emax
